### §2.4 Applicability is an OUTPUT of synthesis, never an input to it

> *"Every research slug gets cross-referenced against a population code, access need or ICF code
> because there is always the chance that there is an unexpected connection between them. If we only
> link our taxonomy to research slugs by what seems obvious, we may miss evidence."*
>
> *"Until we have secured an astounding body of evidence and synthesized that work while
> cross-referencing against our populations/access needs/ICFs, we are not able to define these
> connections — we are waiting until we have finished our syntheses to ensure we define them with
> evidenced justification, not presuppositions."*

**This inverts the model I have been working from all session, and it dissolves the blocker I called
critical.** I had been treating `item_population_links` as a *prerequisite* — a determination could
not be authored until the applicability edge existed, so A-18's zero links read as a defect blocking
the deliverable, and D-0165 read as the gate on everything.

**It is the other way round.** Applicability edges are **findings**, produced by synthesis and
justified by evidence. Writing them first would be exactly the *"presupposition"* the ruling forbids.

| What I had | What is actually the case |
|---|---|
| A-18's zero `item_population_links` is a defect blocking determination | It is the **correct state** before synthesis. Nothing is owed |
| D-0165 blocks the deliverable | **D-0165 does not block research at all.** It is downstream of it |
| Research is framed by the populations already linked to a slug | **Every slug is searched against every population / access need / ICF code**, precisely to catch connections nobody predicted |

**The operative consequence for the next research batch:** the frame is not "which populations does
this slug already link to" — that question presupposes the answer. It is the full cross-product, and
an unexpected hit is the point of running it.

version: 1
status: ACCEPTED
ratified: false
# Header follows decisions/DR-2026-07-13-pipeline-contract.md: status ACCEPTED (doctrine) on the owner's
# ratification of 2026-07-21. `ratified` stays false: the DR names owner-action preconditions that are still
# outstanding (stage-id reconciliation against the deployed audit trail; the blob-vs-commit doctrine_sha
# convention; the ci.yml doctrine-gate mismatch). Ratifying the corrected contract is owner decision OD-17.
authored_by: Claude
dr: decisions/DR-2026-07-13-pipeline-contract.md
enforcement_level: 2
# CORRECTED 2026-09-02. This line still carried the pre-2026-08-27 ENTITY spine and named
# `Item (ENT-08)` as a stage of the pipeline. Two things were wrong with it. The owner's
# 2026-08-27 ruling replaced that spine with the stage list below -- which this same file
# already carries correctly, so the two disagreed inside one document. And the owner's
# 2026-09-01 ruling deleted the item layer outright, so the surviving copy named an entity
# that no longer exists. Restated as the ruled stage spine, which `stages:` below enumerates.
spine: base -> research -> evidence -> judgment -> synthesis -> specification -> render
stages:
- id: base
  anchor: 'the vocabulary and registry layer every stage points into (D-0167, owner ruling 2026-08-27:
    "it supplies the base information upon which research can perform its task... it''s the first layer
    of information")'
  entry:
  - a vocabulary, registry or crossing map the downstream stages resolve codes against
    from_stage: specification
    when: a cell has no determination row, and an open gap typed by the parameter and by the lens columns that apply states what is owed; a pending row for a lens no figure carries is never written (OD-08)
    carrier_table: gaps
    carrier_column: parameter_id
    references: TD section 3 boundary B10; REQ-040 (OD-18, OD-08)
- id: evidence
  anchor: 'EvidenceSource corpus (ENT-02); PI rule #2 (Sonnet evidence inventories)'
  entry:
  - sources discovered for the topic/slug under research
  criteria:
  - id: evidence-verification-gate
    kind: integrity
    criterion: 'No source the work rests on has metadata_quality=AUTHOR-TITLE-ONLY or verification_status
      NULL (rule #10 existence gate).'
    references: 'PI rule #10; DR-2026-05-13; DR-2026-05-20 (metadata_integrity_status)'
    check: scripts/audit/metadata_integrity_audit.py
  - id: discovery-provenance
    kind: completeness
    criterion: 'Each candidate is checked against the bytes of the payload(s) its search
      actually returned, not merely against a typed exec_id that a batch can point anywhere
      (RC1, DR-2026-09-26-recurring-defect-shapes-remediation.md section 2). SETTLED
      2026-09-27 (phase 2): `search_executions`, together with `search_execution_artefacts`
      (a search-to-payload junction) and `origin`/`mined_ref_id` (RC5, the same DR''s
      section 5), is the ONE event home of a discovery step, planned or not, including
      mining. `derivation_chain` and `search_queries_used`
      stay unreachable and are named for retirement, unchanged from before this DR.
      `search_candidates.surfaced_in`/`surfaced_quote` are the narrower pointer from a
      staged candidate to the specific payload it was read out of. SETTLED names the
      DECISION (which table is the event home going forward), not the migration: every
      pre-existing row took `origin`''s DEFAULT (''planned'') on ALTER, and `mined_ref_id`
      remains NULL on any row phase 2-data could not derive it for. Query the live counts;
      do not quote these as fixed (rule 7a).
      RETIRED 2026-09-28 (phase 2b): `citation_mining.connections_produced` -- the copy
      this criterion originally named as surviving until its readers were swept -- no
      longer has a writer (migration 099 relaxed its NOT NULL first, then a db.py change
      to log_mining stopped setting it; see DR section 5.2(a) -- migration 100 in the
      same PR is the unrelated GAP-053 fix, not part of this retirement). It stays
      readable as history (rule 3:
      committed data migrations INSERT it) but records nothing after that date. A mining
      pass''s yield is found via `mined_ref_id` joined to `search_candidates.exec_id`,
      never via this column, from here on.'
    references: 'DR-2026-09-26-recurring-defect-shapes-remediation.md sections 2, 5 and
      5.2(a); project-shape-audit F-06; evidence-architecture G1 provenance;
      research_protocol_audit CHECK 8, which reads search_queries_used and is the only
      committed reader of that still-unreachable column'
    check: scripts/audit/provenance_artefact_audit.py
  re_entry:
  - id: evidence-from-specification-skim
    from_stage: specification
    when: 'a figure was read by skimming, and the extraction''s own method cell says so; a determination that rests on it is named by the engine as owing a dedicated reading. OD-10 (answered 2026-11-12): a re-read owed is a reading''s own status, a preliminary reading or a follow-up; this carrier marks the skim and does not replace either'
    carrier_table: source_value_extractions
    carrier_column: extraction_method
    carrier_value: skim
    references: TD section 3 boundary B11; REQ-037, REQ-038 (OD-18)
- id: judgment
  anchor: the 4-state determination machine + convergence + directness (evidence-architecture.md §5)
  entry:
  - an admitted evidence source, ready for value extraction and a tier verdict
  criteria:
  - id: handoff-fanout-preserved
    kind: integrity
    criterion: 'The evidence->judgment hand-off is 1:N: source_value_extractions.ref_id is NOT NULL and
      references evidence_sources(ref_id), and NO UNIQUE index exists on that table. One evidence source
      may provide many judgment rows (owner ruling 2026-08-27, worked example: Canada''s NBC 3.8). A UNIQUE
      on the key would collapse a multi-clause code document to a single determination and abolish the
      DR-2026-08-19 §7 dissent contest.'
    references: 'references/project-standards.md 2026-08-27 (items #1 and #2); DR-2026-08-19 §7'
    check: scripts/audit/judgment_handoff_shape.py
  - id: convergence-independence
    kind: completeness
    criterion: Convergence counts INDEPENDENT evidence axes (and, once genealogy lands, independent roots
      excluding committee_assertion), never document/citation count. The root-count substrate exists
      (root_id / root_type / root_ref_id on source_value_extractions, and v_value_independence over them,
      re-derived onto parameter_id by migration 073) and gained its first writer on 2026-09-10, `db.py
      add-extraction`. Derive the row count from the database; the figure previously stated here — "pilot-only
      — 8 rows on a single slug as of 2026-07-20" — was a hardcoded volatile fact (CLAUDE.md rule 7) and
      those rows were deleted by the 2026-08-06 clean-room reset.
    references: evidence-methodology.md §3; DR-2026-07-13 H1 (v_value_independence)
    check: null
  - id: comparator-recorded
    kind: completeness
    criterion: A figure stated relative to something else carries that relation as a row in
      extraction_relations (migration 075, 2026-09-13), not only as a number. A ramp slope given as a
      bare ratio with no linked run-length/landing condition, or a T1 finding recorded as an independent
      measurement when the source actually tested subjects against a code's own stated limit
      (audited_against), is content the book can print wrong rather than merely incomplete. condition_on
      and derived_from both require a resolvable to_extraction_id; v_derived_figure_check recomputes a
      row graded figure_role='derived' from its linked base/delta inputs (plain numerals in one unit) rather
      than trusting the stored value on faith, and the writers refuse a derived row whose pair it cannot
      recompute (T-063), the same posture derivation_sha and K01 (scripts/tests/test_db_integrity.py) already
      take toward a determination. Migration 075 shipped without a writer for the grading or the
      relations; db.py now has them (`add-extraction`, `amend-extraction`, `relate-extraction`,
      `derive-extraction`), and assess_cell.compose_value reads `condition_on` edges from governing rows
      (an outgoing edge makes the claim a branch beside the headline, OR-2).
    references: scripts/migrations/075_extraction_relations.sql; CLAUDE.md section 5 (point, do not copy)
    check: null
  - id: figure-role-stated
    kind: integrity
    criterion: Every source_value_extractions row created after migration 075 applied states
      what kind of number it is (figure_role IS NOT NULL) once a grading writer exists; the
      eight rows that predate the migration are reported UNGRADED, not failed, until a
      backfill lands. A row graded figure_role='derived' carries a derived_from edge with
      input_role='base' naming what it is computed from, and its stored value must agree with
      what v_derived_figure_check recomputes from that row's own linked base+delta inputs — a
      derived figure is an attestation a check recomputes, never a number trusted on faith,
      same posture as derivation_sha/K01. A row graded figure_role='condition' is neither the
      target of any extraction_relations edge nor the source of a condition_on edge is an
      orphan — a qualifier attached to nothing, the exact shape 075 exists to prevent.
    references: scripts/migrations/075_extraction_relations.sql; scripts/audit/extraction_relations_integrity.py;
      CLAUDE.md section 5(c) (a fabricated/unstated relative figure passes green gates when
      every field is populated and none is individually false)
    check: scripts/audit/extraction_relations_integrity.py
  - id: verified-reading
    kind: integrity
    criterion: 'An extraction marked verified rests on a recorded FULL-scope source_scans reading
      that covers its parameter (catalogue mode at a catalogue_version >= the parameter, or
      targeted at it), and no extraction on an active parameter exists for a source that is not
      VERIFIED or for a (source, parameter) no reading covers (rows on a retired parameter are
      history, as the ledger says). Held at write time by db.py add-extraction and
      amend-extraction; the corpus-wide reader is the check below, red while rows written
      before the writer refused the state stand (derive: run it).'
    references: 'references/project-standards.md, "Owner rulings 2026-10-29 (second)" OR-11a
      ("Yes, require a full-scope scan"); the scan contract (migration 103, v_scan_ledger)'
    check: scripts/audit/verified_scan_integrity.py
  - id: judgment-code-value-identity-not-omitted
    kind: integrity
    criterion: No live figure of a tier 4 to 6 source carries a live ICF or access-need link, no live identity link
      other than the scope marker ALL, at least one group the maps propose for its codes, and a basis other than
      heading on some live link; the audit's list (i) holds every such figure and the check exits 1 while it is
      non-empty. Not part of the criterion, and printed beside it as information, the figures that carry no judged
      identity link (the carried links T-127 replaces) and those that reach no group cell (list iv).
    references: 'references/project-standards.md: "Owner instruction 2026-11-14 (sixteenth set)", "(sixteenth set,
      later", "(sixteenth set, last)" and "Correction and registration 2026-11-15" (the recording session judges and
      writes the identity link; the maps propose); OD-65. Renamed 2026-11-20 from judgment-code-value-identity-judged
      (its only caller, the check registry, renamed with it), because the audit checks an omission, not a judgment'
    check: scripts/audit/code_value_identity_audit.py
  re_entry:
  - id: judgment-from-specification-skim
    from_stage: specification
    when: 'a figure was read by skimming, and the extraction''s own method cell says so; a determination that rests on it is named by the engine as owing a dedicated reading. OD-10 (answered 2026-11-12): a re-read owed is a reading''s own status, a preliminary reading or a follow-up; this carrier marks the skim and does not replace either'
    carrier_table: source_value_extractions
    carrier_column: extraction_method
    carrier_value: skim
    references: TD section 3 boundary B11; REQ-037, REQ-038 (OD-18)
- id: synthesis
  anchor: 'best_practice_synthesis / ISW; PI rule #9 (9-step); Opus-class or above, Fable included (rule #2)'

content.content:
row["ref_id"] = ref
        # AN EXTRACTION IS A READING. A source whose existence is not established
        # (verification_status UNVERIFIED or NULL, D-0157) was never obtained, and the
        # skill says never to describe it as read; a value attributed to it is a claim
        # about a document nobody held. Live rows already sit on such sources (derive:
        # SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_value_extractions x JOIN evidence_sources e USING
        # (ref_id) WHERE COALESCE(e.verification_status,'') <> 'VERIFIED'); they are
        # history, and this refusal stops the next one.
        _vs = conn.execute("SELECT verification_status FROM evidence_sources WHERE ref_id=?",
                           (ref,)).fetchone()[0]
        if _vs != "VERIFIED":
            raise Refusal(
                f"add-extraction: {ref} is {_vs or 'NULL'}, not VERIFIED. An extraction is a "
                f"reading of a document this project obtained; a source whose standing is "
                f"not established cannot have been read. Retrieve and verify it first "
                f"(R10; db.py amend-source), or admit it UNVERIFIED and leave it unread. "
                f"Nothing was written.")

        # A slug guides what is searched, not what is read (scan contract, LED-195): no slug is
        # asked for here, and `source_slug_links` stays the admission record. A root_id names a
        # row of the registry (migration 114); an in-corpus root is root_ref_id.
        if row.get("root_id") is not None and not dbcore.exists(
                conn, "external_root_registry", "root_id", row["root_id"]):
            raise Refusal(
                f"root_id {row['root_id']!r} is not in external_root_registry. A root_id names an "
                f"external root; a root held in this corpus is --root-ref-id. Register the root "
                f"first with `db.py register-root`, then give its id here.")

        # --- the subject -----------------------------------------------------
        pid = row.get("parameter_id")
        if pid is None:
            raise Refusal(
                "--parameter-id is required: an extraction whose subject is unknown "
                "cannot reach the determination it exists to support (owner 2026-08-26, "
                "'the judgment object is the canonical parameter').")
        n_params = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_parameters").fetchone()[0]
        if n_params == 0:
            raise Refusal(
                "`base_parameters` holds no rows, so NO parameter_id can be valid and a "
                "bare INSERT would fail with `FOREIGN KEY constraint failed` — a refusal "
                "that names neither the cause nor the fix (CLAUDE.md §4).\n"
                "Mint the subject first, from an adjudicated term:\n"
                "  db.py add-parameter --term-id TERM-NNN --quantity-kind K --quantity-kind-quote Q --quantity-kind-source-url U --quantity-kind-source-page P --session ...")
        prow = conn.execute("SELECT status, merged_into FROM base_parameters "
                            "WHERE parameter_id=?", (pid,)).fetchone()
        if prow is None:
            raise Refusal(
                f"parameter_id {pid}: no such parameter. Mint one from a term:\n"
                f"  db.py add-parameter --term-id TERM-NNN --quantity-kind K --quantity-kind-quote Q --quantity-kind-source-url U --quantity-kind-source-page P --session ...")
        if prow["status"] != "active":
            target = f" (merged into {prow['merged_into']})" if prow["merged_into"] else ""
            raise Refusal(
                f"parameter_id {pid} is {prow['status']}{target}, not active. Key the "
                f"extraction on the surviving parameter — a value filed under a folded "
                f"parameter is unreachable from the determination that replaced it.")

        # --- the reading record (R16, OR-11a) --------------------------------
        # The reading comes first and leaves a source_scans row; what it found is this
        # row. An extraction with no covering reading is consumed before it was read
        # (adversarial lens S4-sequence). `verified` additionally needs the reading to
        # be full-scope (OR-11a, owner 2026-10-29). Both were stated by the skill and
        # held by nothing; the live rows that lack a covering reading are history (derive
        # the verified ones: python3 scripts/audit/verified_scan_integrity.py).
        if _covering_scan(conn, ref, pid) is None:
            raise Refusal(
                f"add-extraction: no source_scans row covers {ref} for parameter {pid}. "
                f"Record the reading first -- db.py record-scan --ref-id {ref} --mode "
                f"catalogue (or --mode targeted --target-parameter-id {pid}) -- then "
                f"write what it found. Nothing was written.")
        if row.get("extraction_status") == "verified":
            _require_full_scan_for_verified(conn, ref, pid, "add-extraction")

        # --- the lenses ------------------------------------------------------
        if not any(lens.values()):
            raise Refusal(
                "an extraction must be stated in at least one lens (D-0182): pass one or "
                "more of --identity / --icf / --needs. A value attached to no "
                "lens is a value about nobody.")
        for col, codes in lens.items():
            dup = sorted({c for c in codes if codes.count(c) > 1})
            if dup:
                raise Refusal(f"{col}: {dup} given more than once in this call. A figure holds one live "
                              f"link per code. Nothing was written.")
            for code in codes:
                _require_lens_code(conn, col, code)

        # --- the claim -------------------------------------------------------
        claim_type = row.get("claim_type")
        value = row.get("claimed_value")
        figure_role = row.get("figure_role")
        # A DERIVED FIGURE HAS NO QUOTE OR LOCATOR OF ITS OWN (OD-40, delegated 2026-11-13): its words and its
        # place are its inputs', reached through its `derived_from` edges, each of which carries its input's
        # verified quote. A figure a source states in words is a claim row, never a derived one.
        if figure_role == "derived":
            if "claim_text" in row:
                raise Refusal(
                    "add-extraction: a derived figure carries no claim_text of its own: its words are its inputs', "
                    "reached through its derived_from edges (OD-40). A figure the source states in words is a claim "
                    "row (--figure-role claim); a computed one is written with db.py derive-extraction. "
                    "Nothing was written.")
        # THE VERBATIM FLOOR. `--claim-text` is required at the parser, so this fires
        # on the PYTHON API path and on `--claim-text ""` — a blank is not a quote,
        # and normalising it to None here would restore exactly the zero-verbatim row
        # the requirement exists to forbid.
        elif not str(row.get("claim_text") or "").strip():
            raise Refusal(
                "--claim-text is required and must not be blank. Migration 073 retired "
                "`parameter`, the last NOT NULL column that carried the source's own "
                "words; every remaining verbatim column on this table is nullable, so "
                "without --claim-text this row would assert a value with nothing of the "
                "source's own phrasing behind it. Quote the clause you read.")

        # THE QUOTE MUST BE IN THE BYTES (CLAUDE.md 5(c), added 2026-09-13). Blank was
        # the ONLY thing refused above; the sentence a determination rests on could be
        # composed from memory and nothing looked. Demonstrated during the audit:
        # claimed_value 9999 with an invented claim_text landed and governed a cell.
        # `--verbatim-exempt` is the ledgered escape for text no artefact can carry, and
        # is itself refused when the text would have verified.
        if figure_role != "derived":
            _exempt_note = _require_verbatim(
                str(row["claim_text"]), row.get("ref_id"), "--claim-text",
                "add-extraction", exempt_reason=verbatim_exempt, claimed_value=value,
                claim_type=claim_type, value_as_written=row.get("value_as_written"))
            if _exempt_note:
                row["notes"] = ((row.get("notes") or "") + " " + _exempt_note).strip()

        # THE LENS WARRANT: the words that name the group are the figure's own (or its source's).
        lens_basis_text, lens_basis_reason = _require_lens_warrant(

                          basis_reason=None):
    """A link's warrant: a basis from the column's own CHECK (not `carried`) and the exact words that warrant it,
    which must be found on word boundaries, in the place the basis names:

      named_in_text       the figure's claim_text, or a file saved for its source (D-2: its own words name the users);
      heading             the figure's source_section, its own heading (OD-31);
      study_participants  the study_population of an evidence_population_match row for the source (2026-08-25);
      context             the figure's claim_text, its source_section, or a file saved for its source (the scope,
                          application or purpose clause): the words that state the clause's context, with
                          `basis_reason`, the recording session's judgment (OD-65; the sixteenth set of 2026-11-14,
                          as corrected 2026-11-15). Only on a source of tier 4 or above, the regulatory stratum: the
                          owner moved the assignment for code values only, so a research figure's group still comes
                          from its own words or its study's participants.

    `basis_reason` is given with `context` and with no other basis (a reason beside a stated warrant is a cell with no
    meaning). Returns (the stripped text, the stripped reason or None). WHAT THIS DOES NOT CHECK: that the words name
    the lens code itself. The registries
    do not hold a name for every code (about half the ICF d-codes have no title, access_needs has no name column), so a name test cannot be derived for them; whether the words name the group
    is the judge's (D-2) and the recorded warrant is what a later reader audits."""
    allowed = set(_lens_basis_choices() or ())
    if basis not in allowed:
        raise Refusal(
            f"{context}: a lens link needs --lens-basis / --basis, one of {sorted(allowed)} (the warrant for "
            f"stating the figure in this group). Nothing was written.")
    reason = None if basis_reason is None else str(basis_reason).strip()
    if basis != "context" and reason is not None:
        raise Refusal(
            f"{context}: a reason (--lens-basis-reason / --basis-reason) is the recording session's judgment and "
            f"belongs to basis `context` only; basis {basis} rests on the source's own words, so a reason beside it "
            f"would be a cell with no meaning. Nothing was written.")
    if basis == "context":
        tier = conn.execute("SELECT tier FROM evidence_sources WHERE ref_id=?", (ref_id,)).fetchone()
        if not (tier and tier[0] is not None and int(tier[0]) >= dbcore.REGULATORY_FROM_TIER):
            raise Refusal(
                f"{context}: basis `context` is for a code value (a source of tier 4 to 6); {ref_id} is tier "

                f"words (named_in_text, heading) or its study's participants. Nothing was written.")
        if not reason or not re.search(r"[^\W\d_]", reason):
            raise Refusal(

                f"of why the clause's context warrants the link (for a mounting height: 'typically concerns "
                f"wheelchair users'). Nothing was written.")
    text = (basis_text or "").strip()
    if not text:

            f"{context}: the warrant's words are blank. Give --lens-basis-text / --basis-text: the exact words "
            f"of the figure, its heading or its study's participants that name the group. Nothing was written.")
    if not re.search(r"\w", text):

    if basis == "named_in_text":

        found = _as_whole_words(text, source_section)
    else:

            "SELECT study_population FROM evidence_population_match WHERE source_ref=?", (ref_id,)))

CREATE VIEW v_item_provenance AS
SELECT
    bp.parameter_id,
    t.canonical_en              AS parameter_name,
    t.domain                    AS parameter_domain,
    ecs.specification_id,
    COALESCE(ecs.identity_code, ecs.icf_code, ecs.needs_code) AS lens_code,
    ecs.state                   AS cell_state,
    ecs.tier_basis,
    ecs.regulatory_stratum_only,
    csl.role                    AS source_role,
    es.ref_id,
    es.pub_title,
    -- POINTER, NOT COPY (migration 063). Was `es.author_display`, a writer-retired
    -- tombstone reading NULL. The authors have one home, evidence_source_authors, and
    -- v_evidence_authors renders it.
    va.author_display,
    es.pub_year,
    es.tier                     AS source_tier,
    es.evidence_type,
    es.verification_status,
    es.jurisdiction
FROM base_parameters bp
JOIN terms t                            ON t.term_id           = bp.term_id
JOIN "specifications" ecs               ON ecs.parameter_id    = bp.parameter_id
JOIN "specification_source_links" csl   ON csl.specification_id = ecs.specification_id
JOIN evidence_sources es                ON es.ref_id           = csl.ref_id
                                        AND es.superseded_by_ref_id IS NULL
LEFT JOIN v_evidence_authors va         ON va.ref_id           = es.ref_id
WHERE ecs.retired_at IS NULL
  AND bp.status = 'active'

    def at_least_one_lens(self) -> "EvidenceStateRecord":
        """D-0182, mechanised: absence in a lens is fine, absence in ALL is not.

        This is the Python side of the live table's
        `CHECK (COALESCE(identity_code, icf_code, needs_code)
        IS NOT NULL)`. It was "exactly one" under the 2026-08-28 ruling and D-0182
        relaxed it; stating a determination in several lenses at once is the ideal,
        not a violation.
        """
        if (
            self.identity_code is None
            and self.icf_code is None
            and self.needs_code is None
        ):

                "A determination must be stated in at least one lens: set one or "
                "more of identity_code / icf_code / needs_code "
                "(D-0182). A cell in no lens is a cell about nobody."
            )
        return self

# Rulings on the evidence stage, the judgment stage, and how groups attach — a collation

Collated 2026-11-28 in `session_2026-11-28-param-13-rise-landings`, by reading the repository only (no web, no DB
writes). **This is a collation, not a plan and not a ruling.** Nothing here decides anything.

How to read it:

- **Line numbers** come from `git grep -n` at the time of writing. The ledger is append-only, so they should hold, but
  re-check with `git grep -n -F "<first words of the quote>" references/project-standards.md`.
- **Who said it** uses five labels:
  - **OWNER TYPED**: words the ledger records as the owner's own typing.
  - **OWNER SELECTED A LABELLED OPTION**: the owner picked from a menu; the words are the option's label, not the owner's.
  - **OWNER RATIFIED A DRAFTED DEFAULT**: the 2026-11-19 "Sure, append. Ratify all." covered resolutions an adjudicator
    drafted. The ledger gives some of them status ANSWERED BY THE OWNER, but the words are the adjudicator's.
  - **DELEGATED RESOLUTION, not the owner's**: the ledger itself says "not an owner statement".
  - **DR RATIONALE / RECORD**: a recorder's or session's reasoning, or a decision record's text.
- **Bears on**: (a) what evidence is and may refuse or require; (b) what judgment is, does and decides; (c) how groups
  (identity, ICF, access need) attach to figures and parameters, including parameter domains and categories.
- **The quote column is verbatim.** Ellipses inside a quote are the ledger's own unless marked `[…]`. A recorder's
  reading is never put in the quote column.
- **`.ignore` caveat**: `sessions/`, `_archived/`, `audits/` and `versions/` were searched with `git grep` (for
  example `git grep -n -i -E 'domains? (should|must) be automatically|automatically relate parameters' -- sessions
  _archived audits versions`, which returned nothing). The transcripts under `transcripts/` were **not** read line by

## 2. What the owner's own words settle

Only rows labelled OWNER TYPED or OWNER SELECTED are used. Where a proposition needs a recorder's reading to stand,
that is said.

1. **The judgment object is the parameter.** A determination is keyed on the design parameter, not on an item and not on
   a slug × population pair. (Row 4, a selected option. CLAUDE.md:390-393 carries it.)
2. **Stage order, and the two stage verbs.** Evidence comes before judgment ("evidence research, judge evidence"; "we go
   evidence>judgment>synthesis"). On 2026-11-28 the owner defined them: "Evidence is the recording of our research, and
   Judgment is the vetting of it to show saliency." Both the fifth and sixth statements are marked mission critical.
   (Rows 5, 10, 65, 66.)
3. **One source yields many judgment rows.** (Row 7.)
4. **What evidence does (2026-08-27).** Evidence logs the source and its identifiers and type, does cursory scans, and
   lists every concept, topic, key word and phrase. Judgment "will actually do the deep read" and "derives
   value/process/figure/goal". (Rows 8, 10.)
5. **Judgment gives the tier verdict, and the tier is computed.** Judgment "delivers a verdict on an evidence item for
   what tier of evidence hierarchy it belongs to". "od70 yes" answers "type and scope judged, tier computed".
   Determinations are computed ("you have to compute it"). (Rows 8, 20, 37.)
6. **Relevance is an adjudication made at evidence (2026-08-27).** "evidence states relevant items, and relevancy is
   something that must be adjudicated against a topic/category/concept." (Row 12, D-0174, owner.) How this sits with
   proposition 7 is open (§3, conflict C3).
7. **Evidence is not refused for want of a classification (2026-11-28).** Judgment supplies what evidence cannot
   determine: "the missing domains/values/relationships/etc". In doing so, judgment "thereby determine[s] admissible".
   Evidence that cannot log its own domain "still needs to be approved so that the judgment phase can properly assign
   the domain and consequently the relevant groups". All three statements are marked mission critical.
   (Rows 58, 60, 61, 64, 66.)
8. **Domains connect parameters to groups automatically.** "Domains should be automatically connected
   identities/ICF/needs." "this is why we have categories for parameters too: so that we can automatically relate
   parameters to their needs." The worked case is ramps: "circulation related", keying "on to all identities/ICF/access
   needs that are concerned with mobility and circulation", and "ramps do not specifically need to state populations".

9. **A category is the overall class of a parameter, and the list is not fixed.** "like the overall class of a parameter
   eg circulation for all the ones that deal with ramps and stairs and corridors and doors etc." "list of topic areas
   is not fixed". (Rows 37, 39.) Holding the list "as rows extended by data with a warrant" is a delegated resolution
   that the owner's "Ratify all" covered, not the owner's words. (Row 40.)
10. **The scope chain.** "Universal/Population Specific/Individual relates to Identity/ICF/Access Needs relates to
    accessible design domains under which parameters are categorized." The owner's words do not say which scope pairs
    with which lens. (Row 63.)
11. **There are three lenses: identity, ICF, access need.** The medical lens is deleted (rows 14, 36). Within the
    three, a link "MUST be tied to at least one" and "ideally it ties into many" (row 17). Many rows per source or concept
    are fine (row 15). Several codes on one figure are carried by a link table (rows 25 and 29: OR-1c typed, OD-39

    of the three approaches (row 45).

    judgment.** "all code values will have a lens even if it's not explicitly stated. use contextual judgment"; "at the

    height, clearance height and any clearance go to wheelchair users (stated as "typically"). ICF and access-need

## 3. Conflicts and open points

None is resolved here. "Who resolves" follows CLAUDE.md rule 0 (a live owner statement supersedes on contact) and §8
(doctrine, population taxonomy and evidence-tier definitions are the owner's). It also follows the 2026-11-27 reach of
the Opus grant: it does not reach "what the owner meant by the owner's own words, population-taxonomy structure" (8689).

**C1. D-0182's "a link MUST be tied to at least one" against "evidence shouldn't be getting refused because it doesn't
have a classification yet".**
- Rows: 17 against 58, 61, 64.
- The recorder already read D-0182 as governing "the judged link, not the logging of evidence" and left it to the owner
  (row 62).
- Reading A, D-0182 governs every extraction at recording (the tools today):
  - `add-extraction` keeps refusing a figure with no lens (scripts/db.py:12133-12137).
  - A research figure whose own words name no group cannot be recorded at all (C2).
  - The owner's 2026-11-28 words are not met.
- Reading B, D-0182 governs the judged link and the determination only:
  - `add-extraction` accepts a figure with no lens.
  - Something marks the figure as awaiting judgment (the proposal in GAP-388).
  - The lens CHECK on `specifications` (`COALESCE(identity_code, icf_code, needs_code) IS NOT NULL`) and
    `schemas/evidence_state.py:203-223` are untouched.
  - `assess_cell._lens_clause` already ignores a figure that has no live link, so such a figure reaches no cell until
    judged.
- Who resolves: the owner (the meaning of the owner's own D-0182 words, and a lens rule).

**C2. The `context` lens basis is limited to tier 4-6, which makes a research figure that names no group
unrecordable.**
- Rows: 33 ("all code values") against 56 and 58 (ramps need not state populations; no refusal for want of a
  classification).
- `_require_lens_warrant` refuses basis `context` unless the source is tier ≥ `dbcore.REGULATORY_FROM_TIER`
  (scripts/db.py:11752-11759). It gives the reason that the owner "moved the contextual assignment … for code values
  only".
- A T1-T3 figure therefore needs its group in its own words, its heading or its study's participants, or it cannot be
  written at all.
- Reading A (rows 31-33 confine contextual assignment to codes): the refusal stands, and research figures without named
  groups are lost at recording.
- Reading B (rows 56-61 generalise it through the domain): the tier limit goes or is bypassed by a no-lens path.
- Who resolves: the owner.

**C3. D-0174 "relevancy … must be adjudicated" at evidence against "Judgment is the vetting of it to show saliency" and
judgment determining "admissible".**
- Rows: 12, 13 against 64, 65.
- D-0174's rationale says "relevance must be settled at collection or nothing can be admitted" (row 13). The
  2026-11-28 statements place the finding of admissibility in judgment.
- "Relevance" (against a topic, at collection) and "saliency" or "admissible" (at judgment) may name different acts.
  The ledger's READING under the fifth statement says "this statement may move part of admission; whether it does is
  the owner's to say" (9108).
- Reading A, both stand as different acts: evidence keeps admitting a source as relevant to a topic, and judgment
  decides whether each figure is admissible for a determination. The tools would need an admissibility outcome at
  judgment, which does not exist as a column today [UNVERIFIED: no column was searched for by that name].
- Reading B, the 2026-11-28 words supersede D-0174's "must be settled at collection": admission becomes recording, and
  admissibility moves wholly to judgment.
- Who resolves: the owner.

**C4. CLAUDE.md §3's table against "Evidence is the recording of our research, and Judgment is the vetting of it to show
saliency".**
- Rows: CLAUDE.md:256-257 against 65.
- "What was admitted, its identity and its verification" puts admission at evidence. "Whether it is sound, and how it
  weighs" does not name saliency, domain assignment or admissibility.
- By rule 0 the live statement supersedes CLAUDE.md, which "is what to correct". The ledger's READING says whether
  the table is amended "is the owner's to say" (9113).
- What it would require: a one-line CLAUDE.md edit in a governance pull request, and the same in
  `governance/pipeline-contract.yaml`'s judgment `entry:` ("an admitted evidence source", line 187).
- Who resolves: the owner confirms the wording. The edit itself is the coordinator's under rule 0.

**C5. "the lens is assigned at recording by contextual judgment" (2026-11-14) against "groups follow from the domain,
assigned at judgment" (2026-11-28).**
- Rows: 31-33 and 35 against 56, 59, 61.
- The first set has the recording session judge and write each code value's lens with a warrant. The second has
  groups derived from the parameter's domain, with judgment assigning the domain "and consequently the relevant groups".
- The two may combine (a figure carries its own judged lens where it has one, and inherits the domain's groups where it
  has none), or the second may replace the first.
- Reading "combine": the tools need a domain-to-groups mapping and a rule for when an inherited group and a judged
  group differ.
- Reading "replace": the `context` basis and its warrant columns (`basis_reason`) would fall idle for code values.
- Who resolves: the owner.

**C6. D-0184 and OR-1 ("a figure reaches a determination only through the lens tags written on that figure"; "none for
a lens that no figure carries") against domain-derived groups.**
- Rows: 19, 24, 35 against 56, 59.
- D-0184 (a session decision, DG-REVIEW) rejected crossing at render because "TRAVERSAL MANUFACTURES INFERENCE". A
  group derived from a domain at read time would be such a traversal.
- If instead the derived groups are written onto each figure as judged links, they are tags on the figure, and D-0184
  and OR-1 hold.
- Reading A, the domain is a source of proposals: the derivation writes links with a warrant, and the engine is
  unchanged.
- Reading B, the domain is a read-time join: `assess_cell._lens_clause` would have to admit figures without links, and
  D-0184 and OR-1 would be superseded.
- Who resolves: the owner (D-0184 is not an owner ruling, but OR-1 rests on the owner's "yes").

## 2. What the owner's own words settle

Only rows labelled OWNER TYPED or OWNER SELECTED are used. Where a proposition needs a recorder's reading to stand,
that is said.

1. **The judgment object is the parameter.** A determination is keyed on the design parameter, not on an item and not on
   a slug × population pair. (Row 4, a selected option. CLAUDE.md:390-393 carries it.)
2. **Stage order, and the two stage verbs.** Evidence comes before judgment ("evidence research, judge evidence"; "we go
   evidence>judgment>synthesis"). On 2026-11-28 the owner defined them: "Evidence is the recording of our research, and
   Judgment is the vetting of it to show saliency." Both the fifth and sixth statements are marked mission critical.
   (Rows 5, 10, 65, 66.)
3. **One source yields many judgment rows.** (Row 7.)
4. **What evidence does (2026-08-27).** Evidence logs the source and its identifiers and type, does cursory scans, and
   lists every concept, topic, key word and phrase. Judgment "will actually do the deep read" and "derives
   value/process/figure/goal". (Rows 8, 10.)
5. **Judgment gives the tier verdict, and the tier is computed.** Judgment "delivers a verdict on an evidence item for
   what tier of evidence hierarchy it belongs to". "od70 yes" answers "type and scope judged, tier computed".
   Determinations are computed ("you have to compute it"). (Rows 8, 20, 37.)
6. **Relevance is an adjudication made at evidence (2026-08-27).** "evidence states relevant items, and relevancy is
   something that must be adjudicated against a topic/category/concept." (Row 12, D-0174, owner.) How this sits with
   proposition 7 is open (§3, conflict C3).
7. **Evidence is not refused for want of a classification (2026-11-28).** Judgment supplies what evidence cannot
   determine: "the missing domains/values/relationships/etc". In doing so, judgment "thereby determine[s] admissible".
   Evidence that cannot log its own domain "still needs to be approved so that the judgment phase can properly assign
   the domain and consequently the relevant groups". All three statements are marked mission critical.
   (Rows 58, 60, 61, 64, 66.)
8. **Domains connect parameters to groups automatically.** "Domains should be automatically connected
   identities/ICF/needs." "this is why we have categories for parameters too: so that we can automatically relate
   parameters to their needs." The worked case is ramps: "circulation related", keying "on to all identities/ICF/access
   needs that are concerned with mobility and circulation", and "ramps do not specifically need to state populations".
   (Rows 56, 57, 59.)
9. **A category is the overall class of a parameter, and the list is not fixed.** "like the overall class of a parameter
   eg circulation for all the ones that deal with ramps and stairs and corridors and doors etc." "list of topic areas
   is not fixed". (Rows 37, 39.) Holding the list "as rows extended by data with a warrant" is a delegated resolution
   that the owner's "Ratify all" covered, not the owner's words. (Row 40.)
10. **The scope chain.** "Universal/Population Specific/Individual relates to Identity/ICF/Access Needs relates to
    accessible design domains under which parameters are categorized." The owner's words do not say which scope pairs
    with which lens. (Row 63.)
11. **There are three lenses: identity, ICF, access need.** The medical lens is deleted (rows 14, 36). Within the
    three, a link "MUST be tied to at least one" and "ideally it ties into many" (row 17). Many rows per source or concept

    selected). Disability identity is the lens "by far the most common" for navigation (row 41). A browsing user picks one

12. **Code values always carry a lens, assigned by contextual judgment at the moment of recording, and the lens is in
    judgment.** "all code values will have a lens even if it's not explicitly stated. use contextual judgment"; "at the
    moment of recording the row is when you will have best idea of context"; "yes lens in judgment". Defaults: mounting
    height, clearance height and any clearance go to wheelchair users (stated as "typically"). ICF and access-need
    lenses also reach populations ("populations still get coded as a result"). (Rows 31-33.) The words name *code
    values*. Whether the 2026-11-28 domain route (proposition 8) replaces this or adds to it is open (§3, C5).

## 3. Conflicts and open points

None is resolved here. "Who resolves" follows CLAUDE.md rule 0 (a live owner statement supersedes on contact) and §8
(doctrine, population taxonomy and evidence-tier definitions are the owner's). It also follows the 2026-11-27 reach of
the Opus grant: it does not reach "what the owner meant by the owner's own words, population-taxonomy structure" (8689).

**C1. D-0182's "a link MUST be tied to at least one" against "evidence shouldn't be getting refused because it doesn't
have a classification yet".**
- Rows: 17 against 58, 61, 64.
- The recorder already read D-0182 as governing "the judged link, not the logging of evidence" and left it to the owner
  (row 62).
- Reading A, D-0182 governs every extraction at recording (the tools today):
  - `add-extraction` keeps refusing a figure with no lens (scripts/db.py:12133-12137).
  - A research figure whose own words name no group cannot be recorded at all (C2).
  - The owner's 2026-11-28 words are not met.
- Reading B, D-0182 governs the judged link and the determination only:
  - `add-extraction` accepts a figure with no lens.
  - Something marks the figure as awaiting judgment (the proposal in GAP-388).
  - The lens CHECK on `specifications` (`COALESCE(identity_code, icf_code, needs_code) IS NOT NULL`) and
    `schemas/evidence_state.py:203-223` are untouched.
  - `assess_cell._lens_clause` already ignores a figure that has no live link, so such a figure reaches no cell until
    judged.
- Who resolves: the owner (the meaning of the owner's own D-0182 words, and a lens rule).

**C2. The `context` lens basis is limited to tier 4-6, which makes a research figure that names no group
unrecordable.**
- Rows: 33 ("all code values") against 56 and 58 (ramps need not state populations; no refusal for want of a
  classification).
- `_require_lens_warrant` refuses basis `context` unless the source is tier ≥ `dbcore.REGULATORY_FROM_TIER`
  (scripts/db.py:11752-11759). It gives the reason that the owner "moved the contextual assignment … for code values
  only".
- A T1-T3 figure therefore needs its group in its own words, its heading or its study's participants, or it cannot be
  written at all.
- Reading A (rows 31-33 confine contextual assignment to codes): the refusal stands, and research figures without named
  groups are lost at recording.
- Reading B (rows 56-61 generalise it through the domain): the tier limit goes or is bypassed by a no-lens path.
- Who resolves: the owner.

**C3. D-0174 "relevancy … must be adjudicated" at evidence against "Judgment is the vetting of it to show saliency" and
judgment determining "admissible".**
- Rows: 12, 13 against 64, 65.
- D-0174's rationale says "relevance must be settled at collection or nothing can be admitted" (row 13). The
  2026-11-28 statements place the finding of admissibility in judgment.
- "Relevance" (against a topic, at collection) and "saliency" or "admissible" (at judgment) may name different acts.
  The ledger's READING under the fifth statement says "this statement may move part of admission; whether it does is
  the owner's to say" (9108).
- Reading A, both stand as different acts: evidence keeps admitting a source as relevant to a topic, and judgment
  decides whether each figure is admissible for a determination. The tools would need an admissibility outcome at
  judgment, which does not exist as a column today [UNVERIFIED: no column was searched for by that name].
- Reading B, the 2026-11-28 words supersede D-0174's "must be settled at collection": admission becomes recording, and
  admissibility moves wholly to judgment.
- Who resolves: the owner.

**C4. CLAUDE.md §3's table against "Evidence is the recording of our research, and Judgment is the vetting of it to show
saliency".**
- Rows: CLAUDE.md:256-257 against 65.
- "What was admitted, its identity and its verification" puts admission at evidence. "Whether it is sound, and how it
  weighs" does not name saliency, domain assignment or admissibility.
- By rule 0 the live statement supersedes CLAUDE.md, which "is what to correct". The ledger's READING says whether
  the table is amended "is the owner's to say" (9113).
- What it would require: a one-line CLAUDE.md edit in a governance pull request, and the same in
  `governance/pipeline-contract.yaml`'s judgment `entry:` ("an admitted evidence source", line 187).
- Who resolves: the owner confirms the wording. The edit itself is the coordinator's under rule 0.

**C5. "the lens is assigned at recording by contextual judgment" (2026-11-14) against "groups follow from the domain,
assigned at judgment" (2026-11-28).**
- Rows: 31-33 and 35 against 56, 59, 61.
- The first set has the recording session judge and write each code value's lens with a warrant. The second has
  groups derived from the parameter's domain, with judgment assigning the domain "and consequently the relevant groups".
- The two may combine (a figure carries its own judged lens where it has one, and inherits the domain's groups where it
  has none), or the second may replace the first.
- Reading "combine": the tools need a domain-to-groups mapping and a rule for when an inherited group and a judged
  group differ.
- Reading "replace": the `context` basis and its warrant columns (`basis_reason`) would fall idle for code values.
- Who resolves: the owner.

**C6. D-0184 and OR-1 ("a figure reaches a determination only through the lens tags written on that figure"; "none for
a lens that no figure carries") against domain-derived groups.**
- Rows: 19, 24, 35 against 56, 59.
- D-0184 (a session decision, DG-REVIEW) rejected crossing at render because "TRAVERSAL MANUFACTURES INFERENCE". A
  group derived from a domain at read time would be such a traversal.
- If instead the derived groups are written onto each figure as judged links, they are tags on the figure, and D-0184
  and OR-1 hold.
- Reading A, the domain is a source of proposals: the derivation writes links with a warrant, and the engine is
  unchanged.
- Reading B, the domain is a read-time join: `assess_cell._lens_clause` would have to admit figures without links, and
  D-0184 and OR-1 would be superseded.
- Who resolves: the owner (D-0184 is not an owner ruling, but OR-1 rests on the owner's "yes").

**C7. No mapping exists from a domain to identities, ICF codes or needs, and its content is doctrine.**
- Rows: 57, 59.
- No table or view links `terms.domain` to a lens (§4). `terms.domain` is free text with no CHECK.
- The ledger says the mapping "is not written here: it is doctrine for the owner or an adjudication with a warrant"
  (9098).
- The list of domains is open (row 39). The adjudicated form, "rows extended by data with a warrant" (row 40, OD-69),
  has no table yet. T-135 was held.
- Who resolves: the owner for the content (population taxonomy is §8 doctrine). An adjudication may propose it.

**C8. The scope chain against how the engine sets `design_scale`.**
- Rows: 1, 28, 40 (OD-48), 63.
- The engine sets `design_scale = population if identity else universal` (scripts/assess/assess_cell.py:1413-1417).
  So a cell keyed on an ICF code or a need alone reads "universal", and `person` is never derived.
- Row 63 ties universal, population and individual to the lenses and domains without saying which pairs with which.
- Row 1's Design Modes and the 2026-07-12/13 G1(a) record ("T4–6-only determinations are Universal-Mode regulatory
  determinations", 6524) are the conflict OD-48 was referred for. OD-48 then took the drafted default "whom it is for".
- Who resolves: the owner, since row 63 may change OD-48.

**C9. The provisional MOB workaround against the MOB split and OD-91.**
- GAP-388 and this session's override O12 put lens MOB with basis `context` on every code row
  (`select description from gaps where gap_id='GAP-388'`;
  scratchpad/session_2026-11-28-param-13-rise-landings/overrides-refusals-denials.md:37).
- Row 3 splits MOB into ambulatory and wheelchair user "to start". OD-91's delegated assumption says "neither ramp cell
  may therefore be keyed on MOB" (row 47).
- OD-31 (row 28) allows "the parent MOB with no child" under a mobility heading, but O12's basis is `context`, not
  `heading`.
- Who resolves: no owner question. It is a workaround to retire when GAP-388 ships, and the coordinator should keep it
  flagged.

**C10. "evidence shouldn't be getting refused" against the evidence-stage refusals that are not classifications.**
- Rows: 58 against 21 and CLAUDE.md §5(c).
- `add-extraction` also refuses a source that is not VERIFIED (scripts/db.py:12068-12076), a figure with no covering
  `source_scans` row (12117-12122), and a quote not found in the saved bytes (12165-12178).
- The owner's words name "a classification", "the domain", and "domains/values/relationships". On their face they do
  not reach verification or the verbatim floor, which guard against fabricated citations (§5(c)).
- Whether "refused" covers these is open.
- Who resolves: the owner. Until then a reading that keeps them is the narrower one.

**C11. Stage of the extraction.**
- Row 9 (2026-08-27) makes `source_value_extractions` a judgment table, so `add-extraction` is a judgment-stage call
  (the ledger says so at 7528).
- The owner's 2026-11-28 words speak of "logged evidence" and "evidence … when recording information".
- If recording a figure is evidence's act, row 9's stage assignment moves. If it stays a judgment act, "evidence is
  not refused" refers to something upstream of the extraction (the source, its scan or its observed terms).
- Who resolves: the owner, since this is a stage assignment under row 5.

**C12. Pairing order in the matrix.**
- "should be all three" (row 43) against "perhaps, we select ICF codes" after pairing (row 45).
- OD-73 (a delegated resolution, 8586) kept all three and built no pairs table.
- Recorded here only because row 63's chain (lens → domain) may bear on it.
- Who resolves: the owner.

I wrote the collation to /home/user/guidebook/scratchpad/session_2026-11-28-param-13-rise-landings/rulings-evidence-and-judgment.md and touched nothing else: no database writes, no commits, no web searches.

It has the four sections you asked for:
1. **Chronological table**: 66 rows, each with file:line, the quote verbatim, who said it, and which of (a)/(b)/(c) it bears on. Rows 47-52 (OD-91, OD-92, OD-98, OD-99, OD-100, OD-101) are marked "DELEGATED RESOLUTION, not the owner's", and OD-92, OD-99 and OD-100 are flagged as referred back and still open. OD-46, OD-47 and OD-48 are marked "owner ratified a drafted default": the ledger lists them as answered by the owner, but the wording is the adjudicator's.
2. **What the owner's own words settle**: 20 numbered propositions.
3. **Conflicts and open points**: 12 conflicts (C1-C12). Each says who would resolve it and what each reading would require of the tools; none is resolved.
4. **What the tools do today**: the refusals and schema checks, with file:line.

Ten-line summary:
1. The owner's own words make the parameter the judgment object (2026-08-26, a selected option) and put evidence before judgment.
2. On 2026-11-28 the owner wrote "Evidence is the recording of our research, and Judgment is the vetting of it to show saliency", and marked it mission critical.
3. The same day: evidence is not to be refused for lacking a classification, and judgment supplies the missing domains, values and relationships and "thereby determine[s] admissible".
4. Also 2026-11-28: domains (the parameter "categories", e.g. circulation, a list that is not fixed) should connect automatically to identities, ICF codes and needs. Ramps need not state their populations.
5. C1: D-0182 says "a link MUST be tied to at least one". `add-extraction` enforces that at scripts/db.py:12133-12137, which conflicts with "not refused". No schema check requires an extraction to have a lens link; that rule lives only in db.py.
6. C2: the `context` lens basis is refused below tier 4 (scripts/db.py:11752-11759). So a research figure (tier 1-3) whose own words name no group cannot be recorded at all.
7. C3/C4: D-0174 (owner, 2026-08-27) puts the relevance judgment at evidence, and CLAUDE.md §3 says evidence holds "what was admitted". Both sit against the 2026-11-28 statement that judgment decides saliency and admissibility.
8. C5/C6: the 2026-11-14 rule (a code value's lens is judged by context at recording, "yes lens in judgment") and D-0184/OR-1 (a figure reaches a determination only through tags written on it) may clash with groups derived from the domain.
9. No table or view links `terms.domain` to any lens. I confirmed this from sqlite_master; `v_item_provenance` only shows the domain beside an existing specification. `terms.domain` is free text that no writer requires.
10. C8: the engine sets `design_scale` to universal whenever a cell has no identity code, and never derives `person`. The owner's 2026-11-28 chain (universal/population/individual → lenses → domains) does not say which pairs with which. C9: this session's provisional lens MOB on code rows is at odds with the 2026-08-25 split of mobility into ambulatory and wheelchair user, and with OD-91's assumption that no ramp cell is keyed on MOB.

Not checked, and marked [UNVERIFIED] in the file:
- the transcripts, line by line: owner words that never reached the ledger are not covered;
- the exact rule inside `code_value_identity_audit.py`;
- whether any skill tells sessions to refuse a figure with no lens;
- whether any column records an admissibility outcome at judgment;
- how GAP-388 got into the canonical database (it is readable there; check with `select description from gaps where gap_id='GAP-388'`).

The file carries no hand-typed counts; each figure has its command beside it.
